data.define: Slang for food that tastes amazing.

misuse.text: Don't say 'bussin' about a cold, bland sandwich.

publish.title: What does "bussin" mean?
publish.value: Bussin = That food is really delicious. Example: "Mom's pasta is bussin tonight." (very casual English, US).
